name: Alirocumab
description: A human monoclonal antibody against PCSK9, approved to reduce cardiovascular events and to lower LDL cholesterol.

systems.note: PCSK9 blockade restoring LDL receptor recycling; the labelled mechanism.

monitors.why: Particle count at very low LDL-C values.
Particle concentration by NMR at very low calculated LDL-C.
Modest Lp(a) reduction distinguishes this class from statins.
